s1.syndrome_frame: Postpartum headache with worsening course and associated symptoms
salient_findings: Layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection on noncontrast CT
key_facts: 31 days postpartum after elective cesarean delivery
Initial mild global headache 8 days postoperatively
Normal prothrombin time, partial prothrombin time, and international normalized ratio

raw.syndrome_frame: Postpartum headache with worsening course and associated symptoms
salient_findings: Layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection on noncontrast CT
key_facts: 31 days postpartum after elective cesarean delivery
Initial mild global headache 8 days postoperatively
Normal prothrombin time, partial prothrombin time, and international normalized ratio

shortlist.label: Subdural hematoma
shortlist.why_kept: CT scan showing layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection

shortlist.label: Spontaneous intracranial hypotension
shortlist.why_kept: Postpartum headache with worsening course and absence of meningeal signs

shortlist.label: Chronic subdural hematoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of recent cesarean delivery and worsening headache over time

shortlist.label: Reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Severe headache with normal vital signs and absence of meningeal signs

shortlist.label: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis
shortlist.why_kept: Postpartum state and presence of headache with associated symptoms

raw.rationale: The patient's worsening headache over 3 days, which became severe over 24 hours, and the presence of a layered hypodense crescent-shaped extra-axial collection on noncontrast CT of the head, are consistent with a chronic subdural hematoma, particularly given the timeline of 31 days postpartum after a cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.

rejected.label: Subdural hematoma
rejected.why: While possible, the term 'subdural hematoma' is more general and does not specify the chronic nature suggested by the timeline and symptoms.

rejected.label: Spontaneous intracranial hypotension
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with postural headaches, which is not the case here as the headache is described as nonpositional.

rejected.label: Reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome
rejected.why: This condition often presents with thunderclap headaches and is associated with vasoconstriction, not directly indicated by the provided information.

rejected.label: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and imaging findings do not specifically suggest thrombosis in the cerebral venous sinuses.
